slug: 2026-05-25 Local Infrastructure Lower Costs How Peering Is Moving the Needle on Internet Affordability

facts.fact: BFIX (Burkina Faso Internet Exchange) is in service: the Internet Society says 80% of networks in Burkina Faso are IXP members or customers of IXP members, citing Internet Society Pulse data.
Traffic: 6 Gbps (peak) at BFIX, reached after Internet Society training from 2019, up from 0.5 Gbps; the article gives no date for the figure, so its publication date is used (Internet Society).
